newsitem.title: FRANCE: French stocks close slightly higher.
newsitem.headline: French stocks close slightly higher.

text.p: French stocks ended slightly higher on Friday, snapping a three-day losing streak, after a U.S. jobs report that was roughly within market expectations.
The blue-chip CAC-40 index closed up 3.45 points, or 0.14 percent, at 2,517.97, while the CAC-40 April futures contract closed up seven points at 2,516.

Traders said the U.S. jobs report contained contradictory elements. The drop in the jobless rate to 5.2 percent in March from 5.3 percent was in line with forecasts, hourly wages kept rising, but the number of new jobs was below expectations.
* Sommer-Allibert rose 5.78 percent to 190.30 francs on 1996 results. SBC Warburg, Du Bouzet raised ratings.
* Generale des Eaux rose 2.59 percent to 753 francs. It reported net attributable profit of 1.95 billion francs, compared with a loss of 3.69 billion for 1995.
* Eridania Beghin-Say shares surged 7.06 percent to 910 francs. It reported net attributable profit of 1.66 billion francs, up from 1.53 billion for 1995.
* Renault rose 1.62 percent to 131.80 francs. A French court barred it from proceeding with the Vilvoorde plant closure unless it held talks with the European works council.
